pulse.currentFocus: S351 fully deployed content, staging and the Worker, and took the edge uptime sampler from "held on a permission nobody re-tested" to one blocked line: the KV namespace and binding are live in production, but the cron was refused because all 5 Workers Free cron slots belong to other projects.
pulse.nextMilestone: A founder frees one of the five account cron slots or moves the account to Workers Paid; then enabling the sampler is a flag flip plus two uncommented lines, followed by drain-uptime-kv --dry-run to confirm samples land.
blockers: Edge uptime sampler cannot run: Workers Free caps the account at 5 cron triggers and all five belong to other projects (seamline, studio-ops-cron, veilos, velaxis-proxy x2). Cloudflare error 10072. Needs a founder to free a slot or move to Workers Paid (billing, CANON-019).
604 pre-S349 uptime rows remain unresolvable — a challenge and a real edge outage are indistinguishable in them now the shape is gone. They are labelled, never re-scored, and age out naturally.
[skip ci] publishers do not cascade their derived artifacts, so each one leaves sitemap/lqip/receipt/brief drift for the next session to pay by hand.
Identity/provider acceptance and scoped credential-owner reconciliation remain unresolved independently of this release.
Human signup acceptance, newsletter deployment/arming, Desk cadence, public-member-data, and immutable warm-origin choices remain unobserved or undecided.
Field-vitals freshness requires a genuinely fresh RUM cohort; local lab evidence deliberately abstains.

now: [S351][OBS/P0 · FOUNDER DECISION] Free a cron slot, or move the account to Workers Paid. This is the single thing standing between the studio and ever observing its own edge, and it is now a one-sentence decision rather than an investigation. Five of five free-plan cron triggers are in use by other projects. Retiring one is a live change to that project (founder call); Workers Paid raises the cap to 1,000 and is a billing action reserved to a human under CANON-019. Everything downstream is already built, deployed and verified — namespace, binding, handler, drain, 12/12 drain self-tests.

[S351][CI/P1] The `[skip ci]` publishers still do not cascade their derived artifacts. `b67c283d1 feat(desk): publish the latenight edition [skip ci]` added news pages plus art and changed `index.html` at 22:20
next: [S348][SIL][NEWS/AI/P1] Claim-evidence relationship map + agent critique packet — DONE. Every Desk story now links to a deterministic `critique.json` argument map joining stable fact receipts, stances, predictions, and hash-bound visual evidence. Unsupported claims stay explicitly `unlinked`; orphan cross-references fail closed; no runtime model call is made.
